title: ZAFF harmonic fit with mandatory dissociating geminal X-H couplings
summary: Fit all frozen primitive diagonal curvatures and one explicit coupling for every pair of X-H stretches sharing a heavy-atom center; each coupling vanishes if either bond dissociates.
gates: Morse alpha from the frozen ZAFF seed
each coupling vanishes at either X-H dissociation limit
coordinate_policy: Use every frozen SMITH primitive; fit symmetry-shared diagonal curvatures and mandatory geminal X-H cross curvatures. Each cross term is Kij times two centered bond displacements and two quartic exponential switches; Morse seed exponents set only the damping scales.
backend_policy: ARCHITECT fits the field from the frozen reference Hessian, APOC CM5 charges, and ZAFF seed Morse exponents.
